item.title: Full Album Stream: Fossilization – Advent of Wounds
item.description: Emerging from the abyssal depths of the underground, Fossilization return with Advent of Wounds, a suffocating descent into death metal extremity that sharpens every weapon the Brazilian duo has wielded so far. The post Full Album Stream: Fossilization – <i>Advent of Wounds</i> appeared first on Decibel Magazine.

item.title: Video Premiere: Hibernaut – “Mark of Shame”
item.description: Utah doom crushers Hibernaut return with a harrowing new video for "Mark of Shame." The track appears on the band’s upcoming split LP with Arizona extreme outfit Face Pulp, due March 6 via What’s Left Records. The post Video Premiere: Hibernaut – “Mark of Shame” appeared first on Decibel Magazine.

item.title: Lyric Video Premiere: Master’s Ashes – “Defiance Disorder”
item.description: Featuring current and ex-members of Crisis, Voivod, Dystopia, Crowbar and The Convalescence, Master’s Ashes pulls from the bleak, dystopian heaviness of the early ’90s while sharpening it into something unmistakably current. The post Lyric Video Premiere: Master’s Ashes – “Defiance Disorder” appeared first on Decibel Magazine.
